translations.web: I clothed you also with embroidered work, and put sealskin sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
translations.bsb: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of fine leather. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
translations.kjv: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
translations.asv: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and covered thee with silk.
